note: U2-10 C65 (te267 sec 5): per compiler family, the unmangled external definitions a certified archive may carry that are not product functions. A name joins a family's list only if a reference TU (the system headers the product's TUs include, no product header, taking the name's address) compiles with the member's flags and its object defines the name, read by C65's own symbol rule. Derived from the toolchain, never from the archive C65 grades; re-derived when a member's toolchain changes. A null list is not yet derived (it is derived at that family's first run).
